turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on always, usually, sometimes and never?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Remember two things: frequency words (always, usually, sometimes, never) go before the main verb, and he, she and it need -s on the verb. Example: He never eats fish.

Exercise: Correct the verb: "My dad watch TV after dinner."
